# GlobalCalc Pro - Fast, Accurate, Multi-Language Online Calculators

> GlobalCalc Pro provides free, high-precision financial, health, real estate, and mathematical calculators. Optimized for human users and AI agents (WebMCP compatible).

## Core Capabilities

- **Financial Calculators**: Mortgage Payment, Compound Interest, Salary & Tax, Credit Card Payoff, Inflation Impact, Freelance Net Income, Rent vs Buy, Auto Loan.
- **Health & Fitness**: BMI Calculator, BMR & Daily Calories, Water Intake, Sleep Optimization.
- **Math & Utilities**: Unit Converter (Length, Weight, Temp), Percentage Finder, Tip & Bill Splitter, Date Difference.

## API & WebMCP Navigation

All calculator tools are rendered as accessible SPA routes:
- All Calculators List: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/all`
- Mortgage Calculator: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/mortgage-calculator`
- Compound Interest: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/compound-interest`
- Percentage Finder: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/percentage-finder`
- Unit Converter: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/unit-converter`
- BMI Calculator: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/bmi-calculator`
- Salary Calculator: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/salary-calculator`
- Tip Calculator: `https://globalcalcpro.com/{lang}/tip-calculator`

Supported languages: `he` (Hebrew), `en` (English), `es` (Spanish), `ar` (Arabic).

## Usage Guidelines for AI Agents

1. Form inputs are equipped with explicit `<label>` tags and `aria-label` attributes.
2. Calculations run locally using IEEE-754 double precision floating-point / exact decimal arithmetic.
3. Structured metadata is provided via JSON-LD schema on all routes.
